title: The Complicated rule about the rent
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：complicated　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 complicated 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the director wrote of ① a complicated rule about the rent in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more complicated than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the complicated ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most complicated rule about the rent anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too complicated to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the complicated ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a complicated story of the family, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as complicated as the story of the family they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was complicated or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something complicated, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite complicated; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the complicated ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, in silence, she wrote of another complicated rule about the rent in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more complicated than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most complicated story of the family in the whole theatre, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the complicated ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 复杂（前置定语 a complicated rule about the rent：1961 年导演在戏报里记下的那件复杂的规矩）
B. adj. 复杂／麻烦（比较级 more complicated than：文中两处，一处比租金的规矩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 复杂／麻烦（最高级 the most complicated：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 复杂（表语 too complicated to do：母亲觉得它太复杂，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 麻烦（前置定语 a complicated story of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩麻烦的来龙去脉）
F. adj. 麻烦（同级比较 as complicated as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩家事的来龙去脉相比）
G. adj. 麻烦（后置定语 something complicated：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 麻烦（受程度副词修饰 quite complicated：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a complicated rule about the rent
the most complicated rule about the rent anybody
a complicated story of the family
The most complicated story of the family in

answers.why: complicated 意为“复杂”，1961 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件复杂的规矩”，此处作前置定语 a complicated rule about the rent。
complicated 意为“复杂”，此处用比较级 more complicated than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
complicated 意为“复杂”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最复杂的一件，故用最高级 the most complicated rule about the rent。
complicated 意为“复杂”，母亲认为这件东西“太复杂了，谁也用不上”，too complicated to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩麻烦的来龙去脉”，此处作前置定语 a complicated story of the family。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩家事的来龙去脉一样麻烦”，同级比较用 as complicated as。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，戏报上那半行字要的是“麻烦的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something complicated。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当麻烦”，quite 修饰原级 complicated。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，1971 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要麻烦”，故用比较级 more complicated than。
complicated 意为“麻烦”，母亲 1973 年说的是“整个戏院里最麻烦的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most complicated story of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件复杂的规矩。（a complicated rule about the rent）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更复杂。（more complicated than …）
母亲觉得它太复杂，谁也用不上。（too complicated to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩麻烦的来龙去脉。（a complicated story of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩家事的来龙去脉一样麻烦。（as complicated as …）
到了 1968 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件麻烦的东西。（something complicated）
answers: In 1961 the director wrote of a complicated rule about the rent in the poster.
Everybody said it was more complicated than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too complicated to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a complicated story of the family.
He said nobody would call it as complicated as the story of the family they had once had.
By 1968 the poster asked for nothing but something complicated.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 complicated 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the director wrote of a complicated rule about the rent in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most complicated rule about the rent in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too complicated to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a complicated story of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite complicated, and everybody laughed.
The complicated ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
